notes.claim: The word 'of' can be replaced by 'multiplied by': three-quarters times one-half is three-eighths.
To multiply fractions, multiply the numerators for the new numerator and the denominators for the new denominator, then simplify where necessary.
Half of two-fifths is two-tenths, which simplifies to one-fifth: taking a fraction of a fraction gives a smaller piece.
Area models (a rectangle cut both ways) are used to represent the multiplication of two fractions and to see why the rule multiplies numerators and denominators.
